title: Size of the bribery set after finitely many steps
statement: Let $n>0$, let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$, let $a\\in\\mathbb R$, and let $t\\in\\mathbb N$. Starting from the empty set of coordinates, perform $t$ steps: at each step, set every coordinate already chosen to $1$, and if the resulting function has mean less than $a$, add a coordinate of maximum influence; otherwise leave the set unchanged. The set of chosen coordinates after $t$ steps has cardinality at most $t$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
